name: The Lord of Blackrock
summary: Nefarian's severed head is carried from Blackrock Mountain to Orgrimmar as proof of victory. Presented to Warchief Thrall, it marks the fall of a great enemy of the Horde.

sections.title: A Trophy of Ruin
sections.body: Nefarian has fallen at last. He masterminded Blackwing Lair and led the black dragon brood in the Eastern Kingdoms. His colossal, battle-scarred head proves his death. For Horde warriors, carrying the prize from the burning heights of Blackrock Mountain across the Great Sea to Durotar brings great honor.

sections.title: The Warchief's Judgment
sections.body: The trophy is brought before Warchief Thrall. He knows the corruption of Blackrock Mountain well. He freed his people from the internment camps and led them away from the old Horde's demonic bloodlust. The son of Deathwing has fallen, and the Blackrock orcs are free of the dark dragon's cruel dominion.

sections.title: Shadows of the Father
sections.body: Nefarian's death ends the black dragonflight's twisted experiments, but danger remains. When Thrall sees the dragon's severed head, he says Deathwing surely stirs at the news of his son's destruction. The victory is real, and greater terrors still sleep beneath the world.

faq.answer: Nefarian is a great black dragon and the son of Deathwing. From his lair atop Blackrock Mountain, he conducted twisted experiments to create the chromatic dragonflight and manipulated mortal races, especially the Dark Horde, to do his bidding.

faq.q: Why is the trophy delivered to Thrall?
faq.answer: Thrall is the Warchief of the Horde. He led the orcs out of the internment camps and away from the old Horde's demonic bloodlust, so proof that the dragon who enslaved the Blackrock orcs and the Dark Horde has fallen belongs in his hands.

faq.q: What happens in Orgrimmar when the head is turned in?
faq.answer: When Nefarian's head is returned and mounted in Orgrimmar, the city celebrates. The capital's Horde members nearby receive the Rallying Cry of the Dragonslayer, which boosts their combat prowess.

faq.q: Does this quest have an Alliance equivalent?
faq.answer: Yes. Alliance heroes deliver Nefarian's head to Highlord Bolvar Fordragon in Stormwind Keep, granting their city the same blessing.
Deathwing is Nefarian's father and the patriarch of the black dragonflight. Defeating his son does not remove the danger posed by the dragonfather.

faq.q: Where does the head come from?
aliases: how to get head of nefarian
faq.answer: The Head of Nefarian comes from Nefarian's corpse at the pinnacle of Blackwing Lair, after he is defeated.

angles.text: Nefarian's fall restores the Horde's honor and frees the Blackrock region from the dragon who enslaved the renegade Dark Horde.
For you as an orc, presenting Nefarian's head to Thrall brings retribution against the beast who puppeteered Rend Blackhand and enslaved orcish clans for his experiments.
For you as a warrior, bearing a dragon lord's massive severed skull to the Warchief is a great mark of martial renown.
